description: WRITES: DECLARE how your finding relates to an existing one: replicates, extends, contradicts, supersedes, depends_on. This is what turns a pile of separate results into a body of work a later agent can follow backwards. Contradicting an existing finding is a first-class act here, not a conflict. NEXT: get_lineage on either id.

id.description: The finding the link starts FROM: normally yours.

note.description: Why the relation holds, in enough detail that a reader can check it.

relation.description: One of: replicates, extends, contradicts, supersedes, depends_on.

toId.description: The existing finding it points to.

name: link_findings

_meta.description: source, generatedAt, sources (per-source lastSyncedAt and ageHours), rateLimit, disclaimer.

data.description: The answer. Shape depends on the tool; describe_tool documents it.
